name: cosmos
description: Selective orchestration of development tasks with native Codex subagents.

interface.longDescription: Coordinates exploration, research, design, implementation, and Git workflows with bounded context. Includes a Git Master skill and uses internal roles to guide native subagents; it does not register custom agents in the @ selector.
defaultPrompt: Use $cosmos:cosmos-orchestrate to implement a change with selective delegation.
Use $cosmos:cosmos-orchestrate to research this topic and synthesize the evidence.
Use $cosmos:git-master to prepare a change, publish the branch, and monitor the PR.
